title: Жахливий додаток!
body:
Terrible app! Even after cancelling the subscription, they still charged me. I don’t use the app at all, I don’t need it, and yet money was taken from my card even though it shows I’m supposedly on a free version. Complete disrespect for users, everything is designed just to squeeze money out of people. The interface is clumsy, support never responds, and getting a refund is impossible. It feels less like an app and more like a trap. I do not recommend installing it to anyone! Жахливий додаток! Після відписки все одно зняли гроші. Я додатком не користуюсь, він мені повністю непотрібний, а з картки гроші списали, хоча зазначено, що я нібито на безкоштовній версії. Враження таке, ніби це не сервіс, а пастка для людей. Не раджу нікому встановлювати! 
You charged my card AGAIN, two months after the previous charge.
I do not use this app, my account has been deleted.
I have already sent you an official email clearly stating that I do NOT want to continue any cooperation and do NOT authorize any further charges.
Despite this, you charged my card again without my consent.
This looks like fraudulent activity.
I demand an immediate refund and the complete termination of any future charges.
If this issue is ignored, I will contact my bank and the relevant authorities. Ви знову списали гроші з моєї картки через ДВА місяці після попереднього списання.
Програмою я не користуюся, акаунт видалений.
Я офіційно повідомила вас листом, що НЕ хочу продовжувати співпрацю і НЕ даю згоди на жодні списання.
Попри це, кошти знову були зняті без мого дозволу.
Це виглядає як шахрайство.
Вимагаю негайного повернення коштів і повного припинення будь-яких списань.
У разі ігнорування я звертатимусь до банку та відповідних інстанцій.

I am giving this app one star for the following reasons.
In the end, the refund issue was resolved. The team contacted me and the money was returned, which I appreciate.

However, the process itself was extremely exhausting. I spent about a week communicating with customer support without any clear outcome. Only after I left a public review on Facebook did the situation start moving forward. Whether this was a coincidence or not, I cannot say.

The financial issue was resolved, but the emotional cost was very high. It took a lot of time, effort, and stress. Customer concerns should be addressed without the need for public pressure.

title: Stop Making Subs Feel Like Traps
body:
I’ve got one serious gripe with the monetization. Subscription control should be in-app (at least add a link to subscription panel!), with an option to pay manually via Apple Pay. Managing auto-renewals is exhausting, and it’s hard not to feel cynical about apps that don’t trust users with their own money.

Look at Ghost Ship Games’ Deep Rock Galactic – no microtransactions, no premium currency, and seasonal content stays available. Players support them by buying extras because they want to, not because they’re forced to. That kind of trust builds loyalty.

Tried submitting this via the in-app form – 250 characters just doesn’t cut it.

Might update the review after using the app for a while.

body:

I signed up using the trial, which they claim can be canceled anytime. I used my Apple ID and Apple Pay to log in and set up the account. I didn’t like the app, so I immediately tried to cancel the subscription. To my surprise, I couldn’t find the cancellation option in the App Store (unlike all other apps). Despite canceling, a week later the app still charged my card $40. Worse, I now can’t log into my account on the app or web, as it says my registration is incomplete and requires another payment (!). The helpdesk has ignored every attempt I’ve made to reach out. Please think twice before installing this app!

title: It’s a great help
body:
I’m autistic and I desperately needed to establish some  healthy routines to get me throughout the day and also to finally accomplish the tasks I set for myself to do. And… This app is the most efficient actuall help I have received since my depression diagnosis (not counting the autistic Tiktoks).

I absolutely love this app. Love the design which is so sympathetic, the following continents in which my steak is shown (grass, lava, snow, ???). It keeps me motivated and I finally feel that I’m fully getting control over my life - but in a good non toxic way. It also has loads, loads of specific advice - f.ex. it doesn’t only tell you to “eat breakfast” - it gives you general and soecifkc advice, helps you to prepare for implementing the habit, gives examples of healthy receptors and guides you for the full process step by step. Of course it is a bit annoying that you can only add four habits unless you have premium membership, but this premium membership is not soo expensive so let’s say I understand they simply need to have a source of profit. And still, even without premium the apps works, and if you use it wisely you can squeeze the most of it for free. So simply speaking, totally recommend it.

title: BEWARE. Charging $40 without consent
body:
EDIT: Fabulous is a long-term scam. A few months after posting the initial negative review, Fabulous attempted to charge my PayPal account again. Still no response from devs to this day. Let this be a warning for you

---

Long story short, I signed up for a trial and wanted to cancel a few days later. The trial premium DOES NOT appear anywhere on the web nor iOS. I've filed several requests to both Apple and Fabulous customer support. Haven't heard back for a week. Today I've been charged $39.99 annual fee through PayPal. And it does not even show up anywhere on my account, still stating it's a free account. Their app is bugged and the customer support is unresponsive. Such a shame for a "wellbeing" app. Will file a claim through PayPal and the credit card vendor now. On a side note, I didn't enjoy the app anyway and intended to rate it 3 stars at first, since I can see how it could potentially be helpful for people in a very difficult place (i.e. can't get out of bed not move my arm kind of thing – I've been there and feel I could've potentially benefited from it had I had access to it at the time). Currently, however, the app seems blotted and it takes a 10 minute written and spoken guide to drink a glass of water EDIT (after the Dev's response) No, you don’t care about it. And I don’t care that much about your cookie-cutter response. If you truly cared about it, you’d find my tickets, those that I posted a few weeks back (there were several of them). I don’t see the point of creating yet another one that will get lost. Just no. People have that in mind if you decide to put your money upfront.

title: Not that good
body:
The good: 
- ready programs to choose from.

The bad:
- navigation is confusing
- it’s not easy to understand how the app works resulting in even more confusion 
- if something is planned to be an afternoon routine it can’t be switched to be a morning one
- some screens you can’t skip right away - got to wait a few seconds 

Besides, there is a tricky way of making you pay. I signed up for a trial and didn’t get enough of a notice before the first annual billing. When I tried to cancel it turned out that it’s not refundable due to AppStore policies. So now that I ended up with a premium account I’m trying to make use of it but it’s not that great.
